definitions.explanation: A daily written record of events and personal thoughts.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{日記|にっき}を{書|か}いています。
examples.english: I write in my diary every day.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}の{日記|にっき}が{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: My diary from childhood came out.

notes: Related: {絵日記|えにっき} (picture diary), {日記帳|にっきちょう} (diary notebook).
